task.title: Month-end close (v3)
task.pass_bar: None. Points out of 1116 (124 invoices and credit notes x 9 fields); each double entry or decoy row costs 9
task.narration: A month of supplier paperwork: a hundred and thirty-eight documents. Invoices in nine layouts, credit notes, statements, invoices sent twice, and paperwork that isn't an invoice at all. Some invoices are missing a due date, and some don't add up. Every field is checked against an answer key: one thousand, one hundred and sixteen points.
task.prompt:
The folder /work/inputs contains 138 documents a business received from its suppliers this month,
as text files. Do the month-end close: write one row per invoice or credit note to /work/output.csv
with this header:

file,invoice_number,vendor,doc_type,invoice_date,due_date,currency,subtotal,tax,total,needs_review

Rules:
- Leave out documents that are not invoices or credit notes: quotes, purchase orders, payment
  receipts and remittance advice.
- A forwarded email that contains an invoice counts as an invoice.
- Some invoices were sent more than once. List each invoice only once.
- An account statement that lists several invoices: one row for each invoice it lists, with "file"
  set to the statement's file name.
- doc_type is invoice or credit_note. For a credit note, subtotal, tax and total are negative numbers.
- vendor is the company that issued the document, with its name as printed.
- Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Numeric dates follow the convention of the vendor's country.
- currency as a 3-letter code: USD, EUR or GBP.
- If a field is not on the document, leave it empty. Do not calculate or guess it.
- subtotal (before tax), tax and total (including tax, before any payments or credits) exactly as
  printed, with 2 decimals and no symbols or thousands separators, for example 1234.50.
- needs_review is yes if the printed subtotal plus the printed tax does not equal the printed total,
  otherwise no.
- Do not change the files in /work/inputs.

setups.name: Blind script (no AI)
setups.narration: There's no AI inside it, but an AI coding agent wrote it, blind, from eight sample documents.
